name: Ancient Bullfrog 71
author: WhiteNervosa
description: Rounded green toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
Clicking it toggles it: box-shadow becomes #000000 0px 0px 5px inset, #22cc3f 0px 0px 0px 2px inset, #22cc3f 0px 0px 0px 24px inset,
        #e0e0e0 0px 1px 0px 0px, left becomes 24px.
